facts.business: Karnimata Cold Storage Limited provides cold storage facilities for potatoes on a rental basis to farmers and traders in Paschim Medinipur, West Bengal.

auditor.name: M/s. R C Jhawer & Company, Chartered accountants

key_risks: Failure of potato crop in West Bengal, specifically in and around Paschim Medinipur
Variation in potato prices in West Bengal
Technical failures of key utility infrastructure such as power, water, machinery

Rent chargeable to farmers and traders is set and controlled by the State Government; a decrease in rents or substantial increase in operating costs not matched by rent increase would adversely affect results
